synthetic_temporal_sorting.description: Temporal per-tile 3DGS sorting benchmark inspired by the paper's core QHD result. Traffic reduction and preserved ordering quality capture the central benefit/constraint tradeoff.

traffic_reduction_pct.description: Primary benefit metric: reduction in sorting-table traffic relative to full sorting.

traffic_MB.description: Machine-independent traffic volume penalty, preventing percentage gains from hiding high absolute traffic.

pair_order_accuracy.description: Deterministic multi-scale pair-order preservation metric over local and long-range within-tile offsets.

adjacent_pair_accuracy.description: Local order preservation metric that catches near-neighbor scrambling missed by sparse long-range probes.

sampled_pair_order_accuracy.description: Complementary deterministic odd-offset pair-order metric, designed to catch ordering shortcuts on probes not used by the primary pair metric.

mean_abs_rank_error.description: Average absolute displacement from exact depth order.

p99_abs_rank_error.description: Tail displacement metric for rare but severe ordering failures.

deferred_depth_update_ablation.description: Component ablation from the paper: one variant pays for an extra table refresh pass, while the complete proposed system avoids that traffic while preserving ordering quality.

traffic_reduction_pct.description: Overall traffic benefit retained in the deferred-depth ablation setting.

deferred_update_savings_pct.description: Scale-normalized component benefit: percentage traffic saved by avoiding the extra table refresh pass.

deferred_update_savings_MB.description: Diagnostic absolute traffic saved by avoiding the extra refresh pass. Zero-weighted so larger workloads are not rewarded by themselves.

traffic_MB.description: Absolute traffic penalty for the ablation artifacts.

pair_order_accuracy.description: Deterministic multi-scale pair-order preservation metric for ablation outputs.

adjacent_pair_accuracy.description: Local order preservation metric for ablation outputs.

sampled_pair_order_accuracy.description: Complementary deterministic odd-offset pair-order metric for ablation outputs.

mean_abs_rank_error.description: Average absolute displacement from exact depth order in the ablation setting.

p99_abs_rank_error.description: Tail displacement penalty for severe ordering failures in the ablation setting.
